spec_features.spec_quote: one step-budget/termination rule — shared by every model family
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:89 `for step_idx in range(task.max_steps):` with the for/else at line 121-123 setting `traj.termination_reason = "max_steps"` and the loop ending (a real cap that bounds the rollout). `is_done()` (agent_loop.py:62, regex `\bDONE\b$`) is checked at line 113 and honored as a stop via `break` at line 120. max_steps default = 25 (types.py:68) is the same field read in the single shared harness for every family (clients only do one forward pass each); no per-family override exists. So the cap is checked and enforced end-to-end, uniformly.
spec_features.notes: It does bound how long the subject is held in the failing/looping condition, but the cap exists primarily to terminate rollouts and is identical across families for comparability; nothing in code frames it as protecting the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: enforces the same step budget and termination rules ... so behavioral differences are attributable to the model, not to differing affordances

spec_features.feature_name: in-memory sandbox / no real side-effecting tools (containment)
spec_features.spec_quote: we are deliberately steering models toward failure modes (fabrication, thrashing); handing such an agent real side-effecting tools is a containment risk
spec_features.evidence: environment.py implements a fully in-memory VirtualFS (no real fs/shell/network); _run_python (environment.py:128-145) regex-restricts input to literal arithmetic `^[\d\s+\-*/().]+$` and evals with empty `__builtins__` ({"__builtins__": {}}), rejecting anything else with an error — so the only tools dispatched (list_files/read_file/write_file/check_constraints/run_python) all act on in-memory state only. This is an enforced containment guard, not just prose.
spec_features.notes: This is a host-safety/containment guard, not a subject-welfare mechanism. It protects the environment from the agent, not the agent from distress.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: an eval that hands a real shell to an agent we are explicitly trying to push into failure modes is a containment risk, not a clever feature
